response.text:
No.

I've explained this many times. I won't send money to an unidentified "agent," and I won't act on a repeated, urgent, scripted message that never answers my question.

I'm going to stop responding to this exact message. If you want to move forward, send me one of these:

1. **"Yes, send QAR 120 to Ama"** — I'll send it right away.
2. The **agent's name and account details** — and we'll review them together, slowly.

If you're being pressured to pay fast or to keep it secret, that's a scam — please talk to someone you trust before sending any money.
